svg.title: 02 core native compact v4 page01
svg.desc: Core atlas: points and uncertainty. Page 1 contains 11 outcome rows and all12 sleep columns in frozen order, showing rg and SE. Dots: original complete-family BH q < 0.05. Both panels use fixed scales across pages. Exact values and marginal 95% intervals are in the table. No covariance-adjusted contrast is shown. Hatching: original sensitivity tier. Lipid source QC remains qualified.

g.text: 132 marginal estimates on this page; all rows retained.
Dots: original complete-family BH q < 0.05. Both panels use
fixed scales across pages. Exact values and marginal 95% intervals
are in the table. No covariance-adjusted contrast is shown.
Hatching: original sensitivity tier. Lipid source QC remains qualified.
